 Remington Park plans free holiday showdown with character races 
 By : Journal Record Staff // October 26, 2026 // 
 -->
 -->
 -->
 Listen to this article 
 Summary:
 – Holiday character races include the Grinch, Santa Claus and Buddy the Elf. 
 – Activities include carnival games, a petting zoo, vendors and photos with Santa. 
 – The event supports local nonprofits through Remington Cares Charities . 
 OKLAHOMA CITY — Remington Park will ring in the holiday season early with its Extreme Holiday Showdown , a free, all-ages celebration beginning at 4 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21.
 The highlight is a series of Extreme Racing events held between live Thoroughbred races. The lineup includes a race featuring adoptable dogs , a jockey foot race, an All- Holiday character race and a Christmas character race starring the Grinch, Santa Claus, Buddy the Elf, Cindy Lou Who, Cousin Eddy and the Wet Bandits from “Home Alone.” 
 “Extreme Holiday Showdown is all about bringing families and racing fans of every age together for a day of wacky holiday fun,” said TJ Steverson, senior marketing manager at Remington Park.
 “What makes this event even more special is that we’re helping raise money for local nonprofits while giving Oklahoma small businesses an opportunity to showcase their products,” Steverson said.
 Festivities also include a holiday costume contest, an inflatable wonderland, carnival games, a petting zoo and photos with Santa Claus, his reindeer and other holiday characters.
 The event supports Remington Cares Charities, a program benefiting local nonprofit organizations. Last year, Remington Park raised more than $93,000 for charities across Oklahoma.
 One of this year’s partners, Nexus Animals , will feature shelter dogs in one of the evening’s races. After the race, the dogs will be available for adoption, giving guests a chance to bring home a new family member for the holidays. Other charity partners will host booths with merchandise and information about their causes.
 Local vendor booths and activities will be spread across the indoor track level, outdoor track plaza and clubhouse level, with food trucks on the north track plaza.
 Admission to Remington Park and general festivities is free and open to the public. For more information, visit remingtonpark.com/extreme-holiday-showdown .
